scripts.dev:cloudflare: npm run build && uv run pywrangler dev

INTTEGRO_API_KEY.description: A dedicated server-side Inttegro API key from https://studio.inttegro.com/keys. Never expose it to browser code.

INTTEGRO_DEMO_PRODUCT_ID.description: The active Afterglow admission Product resolved by the trusted server.

INTTEGRO_DEMO_PRICE_ID.description: The active Price belonging to the configured Afterglow Product.

INTTEGRO_DEMO_PUBLIC_URL.description: The final HTTPS origin of this deployment, without a trailing slash.

DJANGO_SECRET_KEY.description: A unique high-entropy signing secret. Generate one with `openssl rand -hex 32`.

DJANGO_ALLOWED_HOSTS.description: Comma-separated hostnames only, without schemes. Include the assigned workers.dev hostname.

DJANGO_CSRF_TRUSTED_ORIGINS.description: Comma-separated exact HTTPS origins allowed to submit the checkout form.
